Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 36 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Sharda - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kavita: "Let's see."

[Ishaan gets into the car.]

Ishaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Ishaan (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan gets off the school bus.]

Kavita (softly): "Well done!"

[Ishaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Ishaan: "Look over here."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan pats his horse.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
